aggregation: same context-drug-dose units as A10 with drug and context fixed effects and 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws
confirmation_set: official A10 ST-HVG zero-shot real-DE tables
deduplication: one reference score per normalized context-drug-dose
direction: larger negative-log dose predicts lower reference performance if the difficulty is shared
error_spending_plan: single fixed reference computation; no predictor or threshold revision
gene_set: the identical official significant-real-DE features used for each A10 condition
hypothesis_source: required corrected closure reference; executable fallback after the hosted table failed to materialize the originally planned training-context mean
inclusion_exclusion: A10 eligible conditions with at least 20 significant real-DE features and finite DMSO baseline values; report all exclusions
metric: signed-LFC Spearman on the same significant features as the official A10 score
normalization: fixed predictor ranks genes by negative log1p DMSO reference mean; score is Spearman correlation with signed real LFC and Fisher-z regression
outcome_separation: the predictor uses only reference_mean; target fold_change and fdr are used solely for scoring
power_plan: one reference look with 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws
prospective_features: administered dose axis and DMSO basal expression for each target context
reference_formula: for each example predict signed response rank as negative rank of log1p DMSO baseline expression, a fixed model-independent mean-reversion rule
sample_size_target: at least 2,500 same-example units and 150 drugs
schema_note: the first 15 C32 rows were inspected to verify fields before freeze; no reference correlation or dose-level reference result was computed
success_criteria: reference is descriptive and cannot reject A10; classify STATE degradation as larger when STATE-minus-reference slope is below -0.02, smaller when above 0.02, otherwise comparable
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose
